I.value_zh: SOP、release checklist、12类文件清单、现有硬编码位置、origin/backup remote 与 TASK/REPORT。
I.value_en: SOP, release checklist, twelve-class file inventory, existing hardcoded locations, origin/backup remotes and TASK/REPORT.
I.notes_en: Actual remote state is not verified.

O.value_zh: 12 类发版文件清单的字段形状未定：原文两次要求每类 6 字段，字段表却逐行列出 7 项；其余升级的 checklist/SOP、TASK/REPORT 双发归档及三方 SHA 记录明确。
O.value_en: The field schema of the twelve-class inventory is unresolved: the source twice requires six fields per class, while the field table lists seven distinct rows; the upgraded checklist/SOP, dual-push TASK/REPORT archive and three-party SHA record are otherwise specified.
O.notes_zh: 不得自行合并类别代号和类别名，或忽略第七字段。
O.notes_en: Do not silently merge category code and name or drop the seventh field.

A.value_zh: 新建 inventory、升级 checklist 和 SOP，运行扫描/readlint，commit 后 push origin/main、backup main 与 backup tags，归档双发。
A.value_en: Create inventory, upgrade checklist and SOP, run scan/readlint, then after commit push origin/main, backup main and backup tags, and dual-push archive.
A.notes_en: Adjudication does not edit or push.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 给出三条红线；ME 执行。
P.value_en: ADMIN supplies three redlines; ME executes.
P.notes_zh: 不从角色推导双远端权限。
P.notes_en: No dual-remote authority inferred from role.

R.value_zh: 原文未给执行时限或资源预算；P0/中风险是元数据，类别、字段、扫描和 SHA 是产物与验收要求。
R.value_en: No execution deadline or resource budget is stated; P0/medium risk is metadata, and classes, fields, scans and SHA equality are output and acceptance requirements.
R.notes_zh: 不以交付数量代替资源上界。
R.notes_en: Output counts are not resource ceilings.

V.value_en: Rule 0.c, SOP §§C/G/stage4.5, TASK-012/REPORT-012 and FCoP front-matter rule.

C.value_zh: 清单应有 12 类，但“6 字段全部填实”与字段表 7 项冲突，完整验收须先明确字段取舍；其余四硬约束、SOP 行号、ReadLints/六扫描、双发 SHA 和归档条件明确。
C.value_en: The inventory needs twelve classes, but the six-field completion criterion conflicts with seven listed field rows; the field mapping must be clarified before full acceptance. Four hard constraints, SOP lines, ReadLints/six scans, dual-push SHA and archive criteria are otherwise specified.
C.notes_zh: 字段形状未定，不能声称已具备完整可判定验收。
C.notes_en: The field schema is unresolved, so complete acceptance is not yet decidable.

B.value_zh: 不得用 `git push backup --mirror` 或 force 覆盖；文件枚举不得用通配符替代精确路径，引用不得用“差不多在那一段”替代精确出处；不得省略 backup 同步。
B.value_en: Do not use `git push backup --mirror` or force overwrite; neither replace precise inventory paths with wildcards nor replace precise citations with approximate locations; do not omit backup synchronization.
B.notes_zh: backup 是发版完成条件的一部分。
B.notes_en: Backup is part of release completion.
